cases.sentence: По ___ рязанского имения, князю Андрею надо было видеться с уездным предводителем.
cases.explain: «опекунским делам» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Prince Andréy had to see the Marshal of the Nobility for the district in connection with the affairs of the Ryazán estate of which he was trustee. This Marshal was Count Ilyá Andréevich Rostóv, and in the middle of May Prince Andréy went to visit him.

cases.explain: «жаркий период» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It was now hot spring weather. The whole forest was already clothed in green. It was dusty and so hot that on passing near water one longed to bathe.

cases.sentence: Князь Андрей, невеселый и озабоченный соображениями о том, чтò и чтò ему нужно о делах спросить у предводителя, подъезжал по аллее сада к ___ Ростовых.
cases.explain: «отрадненскому дому» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Prince Andréy, depressed and preoccupied with the business about which he had to speak to the Marshal, was driving up the avenue in the grounds of the Rostóvs’ house at Otrádnoe. He heard merry girlish cries behind some trees on the right and saw a group of girls running to cross the path of his calèche. Ahead of the rest and nearer to him ran a dark-haired, remarkably slim, pretty girl in a yellow chintz dress, with a white handkerchief on her head from under which loose locks of hair escaped. The girl was shouting something but, seeing that he was a stranger, ran back laughing without looking at him.

cases.sentence: Он, как всякому ___, был рад князю Андрею, и почти насильно оставил его ночевать.
cases.explain: «новому гостю» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: In 1809 Count Ilyá Andréevich was living at Otrádnoe just as he had done in former years, that is, entertaining almost the whole province with hunts, theatricals, dinners, and music. He was glad to see Prince Andréy, as he was to see any new visitor, and insisted on his staying the night.

cases.sentence: Вечером оставшись один на ___, он долго не мог заснуть.
cases.explain: «новом месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: That night, alone in new surroundings, he was long unable to sleep. He read awhile and then put out his candle, but relit it. It was hot in the room, the inside shutters of which were closed. He was cross with the stupid old man (as he called Rostóv), who had made him stay by assuring him that some necessary documents had not yet arrived from town, and he was vexed with himself for having stayed.

cases.sentence: Он досадовал на этого ___ (так он называл Ростова), который задержал его, уверяя, что нужные бумаги в городе, не доставлены еще, досадовал на себя за то, что остался.
cases.explain: «глупого старика» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: That night, alone in new surroundings, he was long unable to sleep. He read awhile and then put out his candle, but relit it. It was hot in the room, the inside shutters of which were closed. He was cross with the stupid old man (as he called Rostóv), who had made him stay by assuring him that some necessary documents had not yet arrived from town, and he was vexed with himself for having stayed.

cases.sentence: Как только он открыл ставни, ___, как будто он настороже у окна давно ждал этого, ворвался в комнату.
cases.explain: «лунный свет» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He got up and went to the window to open it. As soon as he opened the shutters the moonlight, as if it had long been watching for this, burst into the room. He opened the casement. The night was fresh, bright, and very still. Just before the window was a row of pollard trees, looking black on one side and with a silvery light on the other. Beneath the trees grew some kind of lush, wet, bushy vegetation with silver-lit leaves and stems here and there. Farther back beyond the dark trees a roof glittered with dew, to the right was a leafy tree with brilliantly white trunk and branches, and above it shone the moon, nearly at its full, in a pale, almost starless, spring sky. Prince Andréy leaned his elbows on the window ledge and his eyes rested on that sky.

cases.sentence: Перед ___ был ряд подстриженных дерев, черных с одной и серебристо-освещенных с другой стороны.
cases.explain: «самым окном» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.

cases.sentence: Далее за черными деревами была какая-то блестящая росой крыша, правее большое кудрявое дерево, с ___ и сучьями, и выше его почти полная луна на светлом, почти беззвездном, весеннем небе.
cases.explain: «ярко-белым стволом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.

cases.sentence: Комната князя Андрея была в ___; в комнатах над ним тоже жили и не спали.
cases.explain: «среднем этаже» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: His room was on the first floor. Those in the rooms above were also awake. He heard female voices overhead.
